Usage: helper [options] [command] [prompt]

A made-up agent for Conductor's tests, its help in the form commander
prints: one row a flag, the words at a column of their own.

Arguments:
  prompt                                What to begin with

Options:
  --add-dir <directories...>            More folders the agent may read
  --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions  Lets a key turn every question off
                                        later on
  --allowedTools, --allowed-tools <tools...>
      Tools that run without a question (e.g. "Bash(git *)
      Edit")
  --autocompact <auto|tokens>           When to shorten the talk (auto, or at
                                        least 100k tokens)
  --dangerously-skip-permissions        Asks nothing at all
  --effort <level>                      How hard to think (low, medium,
                                        high)
  --fallback-model <model>              Models to try next (comma-separated, in
                                        order)
  -h, --help                            Shows this help
  --input-format <format>               How input comes: "text" (default) or
                                        "stream-json" (choices: "text",
                                        "stream-json")
  --model <model>                       The model to use: an alias (e.g.
                                        'alpha', 'beta', or 'gamma') or a
                                        model's full name.
  --permission-mode <mode>              How questions are asked (choices:
                                        "ask", "bypassPermissions", "plan",
                                        default: "ask")
  -c, --continue                        Goes on with the last talk
  --session-id <uuid>                   The id the session is given
  --settings <file-or-json>             A settings file, or JSON
  --sources [names]                     Where settings come from (default: [])
  --verbose                             Says more
  -v, --version                         Prints the version
  -w, --worktree [name]                 Works in a new worktree (optionally
                                        named)

Commands:
  doctor                                Checks the install
  help [command]                        Help for a command
